title: Protocol for Sleep Analysis in Genetically Modified Adult Mice
author: Iwasaki, Hotta-Hirashima, et al.

steps.title: Gather tools and materials
steps.instruction: Collect all tools and materials shown in Figures 1A‑B, including four‑core cable, detangler cable, pin headers, wire strippers, scissors, heat‑shrinkable tubes, heat gun, epoxy resin (two‑component), multimeter, and hanger wire.

steps.title: Cut four‑core cable
steps.instruction: Cut the four‑core cable into 17 cm pieces.

steps.title: Strip outer sheath of four‑core cable
steps.instruction: Strip 1–1.2 cm of the outer sheath from both ends of each 17 cm piece using a sheath stripper.

steps.title: Remove shields and intervention
steps.instruction: Cut away the metallic shields and intervention layer from each end of the four‑core cable with small scissors.

steps.title: Strip inner sheath of four‑core wires
steps.instruction: Strip 1–1.2 mm of the inner sheath from each of the four wires at both ends using a wire stripper (see Fig 1C).

steps.title: Prepare heat‑shrink tubes
steps.instruction: Gather eight thin heat‑shrinkable tubes (1 cm long each) and two thick heat‑shrinkable tubes (2 cm long each).

steps.title: Insert wires into thin tubes
steps.instruction: Pass each of the four stripped wires through a separate thin heat‑shrinkable tube (Fig 1D).

steps.title: Add thick heat‑shrink tubes
steps.instruction: Thread the entire cable (with the four thin tubes in place) through the two thick heat‑shrinkable tubes (Fig 1E).

steps.title: Prepare detangler cable
steps.instruction: Cut the detangler cable to length, strip its outer sheath at the end with small scissors, then strip 1–1.2 mm of the inner sheath from each of its four wires using a wire stripper (Fig 1F).

steps.title: Prepare electrode pins
steps.instruction: Bend pin‑header strips with pliers and cut them so each piece contains three pairs of electrode pins (Fig 1B).

steps.title: Attach detangler to four‑core cable
steps.instruction: Insert each detangler wire into the corresponding thin heat‑shrinkable tube covering the matching four‑core wire, ensuring the conductors are in contact, then apply hot air with a heat gun to shrink the tubes (avoid heating the thick tubes).

steps.title: Connect four‑core cable to electrode pins
steps.instruction: Insert each electrode pin into the thin heat‑shrinkable tube covering the matching four‑core wire, ensure conductor contact, and shrink the tubes with hot air (do not expose thick tubes to hot air).

steps.title: Test electrical continuity
steps.instruction: Connect the assembled tether cable to a multimeter via the electrode pins and detangler; verify that the resistance of all conductors is less than 20 Ω and remains stable when the detangler is twisted.

steps.title: Fix connections with epoxy and add hanger
steps.instruction: Secure all connections with epoxy resin and attach a hanger wire as follows:

substeps.instruction: Mix the two components of the epoxy resin.
Apply mixed epoxy from the outer sheath to the base of the electrode pins; allow to harden (Fig 1K).
Cover the junction between sheath and wires with a thick heat‑shrinkable tube and seal it (Fig 1L).
Apply epoxy to the connections between the heat‑shrinkable tube and the four‑core cable and to the base of the electrode pins; let harden (Fig 1M).
Cover the connection from the four‑core cable to the detangler cable with a thick heat‑shrinkable tube; shrink it with a heat gun.
Apply epoxy to the connections between the detangler cable and the heat‑shrinkable tube and between the heat‑shrinkable tube and the four‑core cable; let harden (Fig 1N).
Attach a hanger wire to the detangler (Fig 1O).
